maintenance_led.reason: Supermarket chain selling groceries, pharmacy and bakery items to consumers; mostly consumables and first-time purchases.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from household shoppers buying groceries and pharmacy items; some government benefits like SNAP are a minority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by opening and remodeling its own supermarkets in the Southeast, not through regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Shoppers can switch to another supermarket easily; groceries are standard products bought on price and convenience.
